author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Most monitored organizations had no findings; 65 were rated 'elevated concern' or worse at least once.
paragraphs: The Controller's Nonprofit Monitoring and Capacity Building Program runs joint fiscal and compliance monitoring for organizations funded by several departments. Results are on a five-step scale from 'no findings' to 'red flag'. Every row here cites the annual report and page.
Findings cluster in fiscal controls (late audits, deficits, cost allocation). A finding is a review result, not a judgment of the organization's mission or program quality.

templates.template: {reviews_fmt} monitoring results for {orgs_fmt} organizations, {years}: {none_share} had no findings, {elev_fmt} were elevated concern or red flag.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.

caveats.text: Only organizations in the joint monitoring pool are reviewed (roughly those with multiple city funders); single-funder grantees are monitored by their department and are not here.
